Ques. Should I go for B.Tech Electrical Engineering Power and Automation in IIT Delhi or B.Tech Manufacturing Science and Engineering in IIT Kharagpur?
Top Answer By BouncingBantam on 22 Apr 26
Ans. Without any nonsense, it really doesn’t matter what you choose. At the end of your B.Tech, you’ll likely have two options: If you stay in India, you’ll probably pursue an MBA, UPSC, or IT. If you aim to go abroad for research or an MS, keep in mind that no research or corporate job is possible without a taste of Computer Science. The good news is that by choosing B.Tech in Electrical Engineering Power and Automation at IIT Delhi, you can easily transition into CS after your B.Tech and prepare for an MS abroad. Electrical Engineering at IIT is quite flexible and offers a wide variety of courses that touch on many aspects of modern engineering, including Electronics, Computer Science, and Modern Physics. These courses will definitely help you refine your career choices later on.

Ques. Which one should I opt for IIT Delhi B.Tech Mathematics and Computing or IIT Kharagpur B.Tech + M.Tech Chemical Engineering
Top Answer By ApprenticeAlchemist on 22 Apr 26
Ans. IIT Delhi is the better choice, not just because it's closer to home, but because you don't have a specific interest. In that case, IIT Delhi is the best option for you! Here’s why: Flexibility: At IIT, you can explore various subjects. You can even take computer science courses while being in the chemical engineering branch. Opportunities: IIT Delhi offers a wide range of electives and interdisciplinary programs. Networking: Being in a top-tier institution like IIT Delhi opens doors to numerous connections and opportunities. So, if you're unsure about your path, IIT Delhi is definitely the way to go!
